content.title: Data teams that ship with Lattice
content.lead: See how teams of every size build, test and share data their companies can trust.

items.name: Halcyon
items.title: Halcyon gives every trading desk self-serve data on a governed Lattice platform
items.body: A market operator replaced hundreds of nightly scripts with one tested project, answered audit lineage requests in hours and halved the queue of requests to its central data team.

items.name: Kestrel
items.title: Kestrel halves nightly build time so store managers start the day with fresh numbers
items.body: State-aware builds and freshness rules mean sales, stock and waste figures for three hundred stores are ready before the first shift, at roughly a third less warehouse cost.

items.name: Meridian Partners
items.title: Meridian Partners ends quarterly reconciliation across eleven regional desks
items.body: Twelve shared metric definitions, desk-level ownership and tests that check regional totals every day took four days off the quarterly close.

items.name: Basalt Health
items.title: Basalt Health gives clinical and finance teams one tested bed count for twenty-four hospitals
items.body: A jointly owned capacity model, hourly freshness rules and privacy built into the staging layer made monthly reporting forty-five percent faster.

items.name: Tidepool
items.title: Tidepool cuts ad hoc data requests by seventy percent with self-serve product analytics
items.body: Documented, tested event models let product managers answer most of their own questions, so a small data team can focus on new work instead of repeat extracts.

items.name: Ferrocene
items.title: Ferrocene brings sensor and supplier data from nine plants into one versioned forecast
items.body: Planners now trace every forecast figure back to its source rows, and preparing data for each planning cycle takes about a third less time than it used to.

items.name: Larkmoor Bank
items.title: Larkmoor Bank moves regulatory reporting from spreadsheets to reviewed, tested models
items.body: Every regulated figure now has an owner, a test suite and a lineage trail, and the bank’s last two submissions went out a week earlier than planned.

items.name: Northgate Outfitters
items.title: Northgate Outfitters unifies online and in-store sales reporting in a single project
items.body: A retailer with separate web and store teams agreed one definition of a sale and rebuilt forty dashboards on top of it in a single quarter.

items.name: Pellucid Optics
items.title: Pellucid Optics catches production defects a shift earlier with tested line data
items.body: Freshness rules on sensor feeds and alerts routed to line supervisors turned overnight quality reports into same-shift warnings that stop bad batches sooner.

items.name: Sablewood Media
items.title: Sablewood Media gives editors audience numbers they can trust within the hour
items.body: Hourly models built on certified metrics replaced a tangle of exported reports, and editors now plan coverage from one shared view of reader behaviour.

items.name: Aldermoor Insurance
items.title: Aldermoor Insurance shortens claims analysis from weeks to days with a governed semantic layer
items.body: Actuaries and claims managers query the same definitions of exposure and loss, and new analyses that used to need a data request now start in a spreadsheet.

items.name: Cindervale Games
items.title: Cindervale Games keeps live-service metrics accurate through launch-day traffic spikes
items.body: Incremental models and state-aware builds handle ten times normal event volume without missing a refresh, so live-ops teams react to player behaviour in real time.

items.name: Brisa Mobility
items.title: Brisa Mobility plans scooter fleets city by city on one tested demand model
items.body: Operations teams in fourteen cities read the same demand forecasts, built from tested trip and weather data and refreshed every hour throughout the day.

items.name: Wavecrest Studios
items.title: Wavecrest Studios connects production budgets to streaming performance for the first time
items.body: Finance and content teams finally share one view of what each title cost and how it performed, built on reviewed models with clear ownership.

items.name: Juniper Freightways
items.title: Juniper Freightways cuts late deliveries by spotting route problems before trucks leave the depot
items.body: Tested telematics and order data feed a morning risk report that dispatchers trust, and on-time delivery rose six points in the first year.

items.name: Ostrava Provisions
items.title: Ostrava Provisions reduces food waste with daily, tested demand figures for every warehouse
items.body: Buyers order against a single forecast refreshed each morning, and spoiled stock fell by almost a fifth after the first season on the new models.

items.name: Gildmark Exchange
items.title: Gildmark Exchange answers regulator lineage questions in hours instead of weeks
items.body: Version-controlled models and generated lineage replaced manual evidence packs, and the exchange closed its latest review with no findings on data controls.

items.name: Pinecrest Mutual
items.title: Pinecrest Mutual retires a legacy warehouse without a single missed renewal report
items.body: Six months of side-by-side runs and nightly reconciliation tests let the insurer switch off its old platform with confidence and no disruption to agents.

items.name: Tessellate Health
items.title: Tessellate Health builds a privacy-first analytics project across forty clinics
items.body: Identifiers stay in a locked-down staging layer, every access change is reviewed, and clinic managers get weekly operational reports they can act on.

items.name: Lumengrid Power
items.title: Lumengrid Power forecasts grid load with hourly models built on tested meter data
items.body: Meter reads from two million homes flow into tested load models every hour, giving control-room planners an earlier and more reliable view of demand.

items.name: Veridia Energy
items.title: Veridia Energy gives field teams one view of asset health across three countries
items.body: Maintenance crews and planners now read the same tested asset scores, and unplanned outages fell after the first year of using them to schedule work.

items.name: Saltmarsh Interactive
items.title: Saltmarsh Interactive ships player metrics twice as fast with reviewed, reusable models
items.body: A shared library of tested event models lets each game team build new dashboards in days, without rewriting the same session logic every time.

items.name: Kinfolk Journeys
items.title: Kinfolk Journeys prices tours daily with a single, tested view of bookings and capacity
items.body: Revenue managers adjust prices each morning from one trusted model, replacing three conflicting reports that used to disagree about available seats.

items.name: Arborlane Education
items.title: Arborlane Education helps teachers see student progress weekly instead of at term end
items.body: Tested models combine attendance, coursework and assessment data so teachers can step in earlier, with access rules that protect student privacy.

items.name: Quayside Logistics
items.title: Quayside Logistics brings port, warehouse and carrier data into one tested project
items.body: Planners can follow a container from ship to shelf in one lineage graph, and the weekly capacity meeting now starts from a single set of numbers.

items.name: Mosswood Biotech
items.title: Mosswood Biotech keeps lab results traceable from instrument to published study
items.body: Every transformation is versioned and reviewed, so scientists and quality teams can show exactly how a result was derived when regulators ask.

items.name: Redfern Therapeutics
items.title: Redfern Therapeutics speeds up trial reporting with tested, reusable clinical models
items.body: Standard models for enrolment and outcomes are reused across studies, and interim reports that took a month to assemble now take about a week.

items.name: Silverbirch Capital
items.title: Silverbirch Capital gives portfolio managers same-day performance figures they can trust
items.body: Overnight batch jobs gave way to incremental models with freshness rules, and performance figures now arrive before the morning investment meeting.

items.name: Tundra Mobile
items.title: Tundra Mobile predicts network congestion with hourly, tested traffic models
items.body: Engineers schedule upgrades from a shared congestion forecast built on tested traffic data, instead of reacting to complaints after the fact.

items.name: Coralridge Clinics
items.title: Coralridge Clinics reduces missed appointments with timely, trustworthy scheduling data
items.body: Front-desk teams see a daily list of at-risk appointments built from tested models, and missed visits dropped noticeably in the first six months.

items.name: Ironbark Mining
items.title: Ironbark Mining unifies safety and production reporting across remote sites
items.body: Site managers and head office read the same tested incident and output figures, refreshed every shift even on limited remote connections.

items.name: Wexford Retail Group
items.title: Wexford Retail Group consolidates five brands onto one governed analytics project
items.body: Shared definitions for sales, margin and stock replaced five separate reporting stacks, and group-level results now arrive two days sooner each month.

items.name: Hollisgrey Legal
items.title: Hollisgrey Legal tracks matter profitability with tested, partner-friendly reporting
items.body: Partners see time, fees and costs per matter from one trusted model, and the monthly review no longer starts with an argument about the numbers.

items.name: Thrushpay
items.title: Thrushpay catches payment anomalies within minutes using tested streaming-to-batch models
items.body: Fraud and finance teams share one definition of a settled payment, and anomaly alerts now reach the right owner in minutes rather than the next day.

items.name: Driftwood Stays
items.title: Driftwood Stays gives property owners a single, accurate view of occupancy and revenue
items.body: Owner reports used to be stitched together by hand each month. Now they are built from tested models and published automatically on the first business day.

items.name: Cobblestone Grocers
items.title: Cobblestone Grocers cuts reporting costs by a third with state-aware builds
items.body: Most nightly models now skip when their inputs are unchanged, and the savings funded two new analytics projects the team had been postponing.

items.name: Cirrusline Air
items.title: Cirrusline Air improves on-time performance with tested turnaround data from every gate
items.body: Ground teams and operations control share one view of turnaround times, and delays caused by late information fell sharply across the network.

items.name: Emberly Foods
items.title: Emberly Foods connects factory output to retailer sell-through in one project
items.body: Sales and production teams plan from the same tested figures, reducing overproduction and making promotions far easier to evaluate afterwards.

items.name: Granitefield Bank
items.title: Granitefield Bank brings risk, finance and operations onto shared, certified metrics
items.body: Thirty core metrics defined once in the semantic layer replaced conflicting reports, and executive packs are now assembled in a day instead of a week.

items.name: Lanternfish Software
items.title: Lanternfish Software ships usage-based billing on tested, auditable product data
items.body: Customers are invoiced from the same models finance and product teams use, with tests that guarantee every metered event is counted exactly once.

items.name: Oakhaven Realty
items.title: Oakhaven Realty values its portfolio monthly with reviewed, documented models
items.body: Valuation inputs from twelve markets flow through one tested project, so investors and auditors can see how each figure was reached.

items.name: Brightmoor Schools
items.title: Brightmoor Schools gives every head teacher the same trusted attendance dashboard
items.body: Attendance and enrolment data from sixty schools is modelled and tested once, then shared with clear access rules for each school’s leadership team.

items.name: Halden Motors
items.title: Halden Motors links warranty claims to production batches within a day
items.body: Engineers trace recurring faults back to specific lines and suppliers using one lineage graph, shortening investigations from weeks to days.

items.name: Velvetine Cosmetics
items.title: Velvetine Cosmetics plans launches with one tested view of channel performance
items.body: Marketing and supply teams read the same sell-through figures across shops, marketplaces and its own site, refreshed every morning.

items.name: Rookery Publishing
items.title: Rookery Publishing forecasts print runs from tested pre-order and sales data
items.body: Editors and production planners agree on demand earlier, and returned stock fell after the first year of planning from shared models.

items.name: Marlow Freight
items.title: Marlow Freight reduces empty miles with a daily, tested view of loads and routes
items.body: Planners match loads to returning trucks each morning from one trusted model, and empty running fell measurably across the fleet.

items.name: Quenby Labs
items.title: Quenby Labs gives every product squad its own governed slice of shared data
items.body: Domain projects with shared contracts let squads move independently while finance still reads one definition of active users and revenue.

items.name: Tallgrass Agritech
items.title: Tallgrass Agritech turns field sensor data into weekly, tested advice for growers
items.body: Soil and weather readings from thousands of fields are modelled and tested before reaching agronomists, who now trust the recommendations they share.

items.name: Seabright Ports
items.title: Seabright Ports shortens vessel turnaround with tested berth and crane data
items.body: Port operations plan berths from one shared model refreshed every fifteen minutes, and average turnaround time dropped within the first season.

items.name: Kiteline Telecom
items.title: Kiteline Telecom reduces churn with a single, tested view of customer experience
items.body: Network quality, billing and support data now meet in one model, helping retention teams reach unhappy customers before they decide to leave.

items.name: Fieldstone Water
items.title: Fieldstone Water finds leaks faster with hourly, tested flow data across its network
items.body: Engineers compare tested flow and pressure models against expected demand every hour, and leaks are now located days earlier than before.

items.name: Pepperell Apparel
items.title: Pepperell Apparel cuts markdowns with a shared, tested view of stock across channels
items.body: Merchandisers and store teams plan from one daily stock model, moving inventory to where it sells instead of discounting it at the end of a season.

items.name: Norvale Utilities
items.title: Norvale Utilities moves outage reporting from manual spreadsheets to tested models
items.body: Regulatory outage figures are built from reviewed models with full lineage, and quarterly submissions no longer depend on one analyst’s spreadsheet.

items.name: Ashgrove Pharmacy
items.title: Ashgrove Pharmacy keeps shelves stocked with daily, tested prescription demand
items.body: Two hundred branches order from a single forecast built on tested dispensing data, reducing both shortages and expired stock across the chain.

items.name: Orbitly
items.title: Orbitly lowers warehouse spend by sixty percent while serving twice as many teams
items.body: State-aware builds skip unchanged models, and one shared project now supports twice as many internal teams without any additional hires.

items.name: Fernway
items.title: Fernway retires six hundred legacy scripts and rebuilds them as tested models
items.body: Documentation, tests and review came built in, and new analysts now contribute to production in their first week instead of their third month.

featured.quote: We used to spend the first week of every audit rebuilding the story of how a figure was produced. Now the story is the project itself: every model versioned, every change reviewed, every test recorded. Our auditors read the lineage directly, our desks answer their own questions, and the central team finally has time to build the things the business keeps asking for.
